TacticStrike

Read the room.
Take the shot.

Every doorway changes the fight. TacticStrike is a browser shooter built around overhead aim, cover and timing. Get comfortable against a training bot, choose a weapon that fits your approach, then take that loadout into online matches.

PLAY TACTICSTRIKE →

No game download. Use a desktop keyboard and mouse, or a supported controller. JavaScript is required to play.

Getting startedControlsMatches & accountQuestions

Prepare your first match

Choose your approach.

Pick a weapon before deployment. The loadout selection includes pistols, rifles, shotguns, SMGs and longer-range options, with different magazine sizes, firing rates and reload times. A weapon that works across an open lane may feel very different inside a room.

Practice against a bot

Choose a mission area and use Deploy vs training bot to learn movement, aiming, cover and reload timing before looking for an online opponent.

Duel or squad

Match configuration offers 1v1 Duel and 2v2 Squad. Ranked operation options and custom lobbies are available from the deployment menu.

  1. Set your match and weapon. Start with a loadout you want to learn. Open deployment and choose a practice match or online option.
  2. Use cover before you reload. Watch the available routes and move between protected positions. A dash can help reposition, but it has a cooldown.
  3. Make the map readable for you. Compare Realistic and Competitive render styles. Use the flashlight in dark areas and a flashbang when you need to interrupt an opponent's view.

Try Sabotage

Sabotage is a task-survival option, including a mode against a bot. It is a different objective from a standard duel; choose it from the operation menu when you want a change of pace.

Know your keys

TacticStrike controls

Main keyboard and mouse controls. The in-game Settings menu also shows controller bindings.
W A S DMove your operative
MouseAim
Left mouse buttonShoot
RReload your magazine
ShiftSprint
SpaceDash, with a cooldown
1 / 2Switch primary and secondary weapon slots
3Throw a flashbang
FToggle your flashlight

Start with a training match to check aiming sensitivity and learn the map. The game is designed for desktop play; this guide is readable on a phone, but it does not add touch controls to the game.

Play together

Lobbies, names and progress.

Create or join a lobby

Use Create lobby to set up a room, or enter a lobby code with Join lobby. Mission maps include Residential Manor, Neon Cyber-Lab and Neon Arena in the available map selections. Online matches require a connection to the game server.

Your name comes from Account

Open your Unpaused account to create a username. TacticStrike uses that account name for your operative; you do not need to choose a separate name inside the shooter. Guest play is available, and your account also gives you access to Worldloom's account features.

Credits and the shop

The game is free to enter. TacticStrike also has credits and a shop, with optional credit purchases linked to your account. Match records and unlocks are separate from Worldloom worlds. A TacticStrike match is a live session, not a saved world you can reopen later.

Before deployment

TacticStrike questions

Is TacticStrike free?
Yes. You can play in your browser without buying the game. Optional credit purchases are available in its shop.
Can I play alone?
Yes. Use the training-bot option to practice. Sabotage also offers task survival against a bot. Online modes are available when you want to play with other people.
Does it have multiplayer?
Yes. TacticStrike includes online matches and lobbies, with 1v1 and 2v2 match choices. You can create a lobby or join using a lobby code.
Is an account required to try the game?
You can start as a guest. Sign in to choose your account username and use account-linked features such as credit purchases.
Can I use a controller?
Controller bindings are included in the game. On a supported controller, the left stick moves, the right stick aims and the right trigger shoots. Check Settings for the remaining bindings and use keyboard and mouse if your browser does not recognize your controller.
Which graphics style should I choose?
Try Realistic for the atmospheric presentation or Competitive for higher visibility. The deployment menu lets you choose a style before playing.

Build something between matches.

Explore Worldloom, Unpaused's voxel survival and building game with saved worlds and two-player exploration.
